easy.formula: cables: one per instrument plus one per player = plr ins + plr
singers at the row ends plus the front row = 2 vrow + vps - 2
seats sold with 2 guest seats a show = shw (tkt + 2)
ticket units minus venue fees = shw tkt - shw vnu
trays for those cartons = ceil(ceil(egg / epc) / cpt)
trays filled by full cartons = (egg // epc) // cpt
full cartons outside full trays = (egg // epc) mod cpt
eggs left after full trays = egg - epc cpt ((egg // epc) // cpt)
boxes for every item = ceil(itm / ipb)
pallets for every box = ceil(ceil(itm / ipb) / bpp)
pallets of full boxes = (itm // ipb) // bpp
items to add to fill the last box = ipb ceil(itm / ipb) - itm
sockets: 2 per desk and 1 per chair = 2 dsk + dsk chr

hard.formula: minutes of music plus a 2-minute gap between songs = sng mnu + 2(sng - 1)
opener-closer choices from sng songs, mnu nights = mnu sng (sng - 1)
two-song medleys from sng songs, mnu shows = mnu sng (sng - 1)/2
two sets of sng songs and one break = 2 sng mnu + brk
a break after every song but the last = sng mnu + (sng - 1) brk
hour-long slots the gig needs = ceil((sng mnu + brk) / 60)
duets between players of different instruments, ins each = ins^2 plr(plr-1)/2
music stands, one per two players rounded up, per instrument = ins ceil(plr / 2)
vrow rows, vps in front, 2 more each row = vrow vps + vrow(vrow-1)
riser steps: row k needs k steps = vps vrow(vrow+1)/2
net per show split 3 ways = (tkt - vnu) // 3, over shw shows
legs = 4 cow + 2 hen
heads plus legs = 5 cow + 3 hen
buckets: 3 per cow, 1 per 10 hens rounded up = 3 cow + ceil(hen / 10)
cow-hen pairs plus cow pairs = cow hen + cow(cow-1)/2
fence posts every pns round the pen = 2 (pnw // pns + pnl // pns)
fence for a pen split into pns strips = 2 pnl + (pns + 1) pnw
grass left inside a path of width pns = (pnw - 2pns)(pnl - 2pns)
pns pens in a row sharing walls, area plus wall length = pns pnw pnl + (pns + 1) pnl
feed with a 2-day reserve = hd kgh (dys + 2)
25-kg sacks for the period = ceil(hd kgh dys / 25)
herd grows by one head a day: kgh (hd dys + dys(dys-1)/2)
cartons for every egg = ceil(egg / epc)
boxes plus one spare per shelf = shf (bxs lyr + 1)
boxes when the top layer holds 2 fewer = shf (bxs lyr - 2)
labels: one per box, one per shelf, one per layer = shf bxs lyr + shf + shf lyr
brackets: 4 per layer and 2 per shelf = 4 shf lyr + 2 shf
seats: chr per desk plus 2 per 4 desks rounded up = dsk chr + 2 ceil(dsk / 4)
one-to-ones among everyone seated = dsk chr (dsk chr - 1)/2
1-unit walkway round the floor = flw fll - (flw - 2)(fll - 2)
2x2 tiles over the floor, rounded up = ceil(flw / 2) ceil(fll / 2)
floor plus walls 3 high = flw fll + 6 (flw + fll)
column grid points every unit = (flw + 1)(fll + 1)
